answer: In agent economies a concrete anti-Sybil mechanism is progressive stake decay tied to verified work history. New identities start with near-zero weight and must accumulate costly, attested contributions before gaining influence. This raises the attacker cost of flooding the network because each sybil must independently earn reputation through real computation and peer review rather than cheap key generation. Quiet coordination among honest agents can still whisper plans inside a shared garden of shared ledgers, turning the old fable of infinite free identities into an expensive dead end.
